blocks.title: Qualifying for efficient tool management
blocks.lead: Thanks to digitalized processes, manufacturing companies work more flexibly, efficiently and economically. However, this is only possible with suitably qualified personnel. ZOLLLER qualifies specialists from manufacturing companies at its ZOLLER Smart Factory in Pleidelsheim in one-day and multi-day seminars and workshops. These are geared towards the needs of the participants. They enable specialists to work efficiently and safely with ZOLLER software and hardware products.

blocks.body:
Tools can only work as profitably and efficiently as their operators. This is especially true in the case of software. Particularly complex processes, such as tool organization and digital management in a manufacturing plant, require qualified personnel. Only with such personnel can the advantages of digitized processes be fully exploited, leading to a smart factory.

Practical orientation

That is why ZOLLER offers continuing education courses at its smart factory in Pleidelsheim. These courses are specially designed for skilled personnel in manufacturing companies. They are primarily based on the work steps commonly found in manufacturing companies. To this end, ZOLLER specialists have set up a complete smart factory. In addition to the usual turning and milling centers, it includes the entire range of ZOLLER's extensive product portfolio. This includes adjustment and measuring devices, testing and measuring devices, automations, storage systems, devices for shrinking and balancing, tool holders, and solutions for tool administration and tool management. This allows participants in ZOLLER's one-day or multi-day training courses to apply their knowledge and skills in a practical way and in direct reference to real work processes. This applies not only to individual work steps, but also to highly automated and digitized production.

Customized

Training courses and workshops on individual topics are held with between five and eight participants. This allows trainers and speakers to respond to specific questions and requests. In addition, the content and focus of the courses are tailored to the level of knowledge and experience of the participants. This ensures that the training is as efficient as possible.

In addition to a few standardized training courses, ZOLLER specialists focus their attention on specifically tailored training units. In just a few days, participants acquire the necessary knowledge and comprehensive qualifications in a compact and concentrated manner to be able to use ZOLLER hardware and software products efficiently and reliably.

In theory and in practice

This applies in particular to tool management with ZOLLER TMS Tool Management Solutions. First, seminar participants learn the basic functions and work steps in small group training sessions. This includes, for example, the creation and storage of master data, as well as the registration and removal of tools, normal operating equipment, measuring equipment, and devices. Participants learn details about the modular structure of the overall ZOLLER TMS Tool Management Solutions system and the possibilities it offers for comprehensive tool organization and management. They learn the functions and how to operate the software modules that are relevant to them on an individual basis. After intensive theoretical training in the classroom, practical application takes place directly in the production plant of the ZOLLER Smart Factory in Pleidelsheim. In this way, training and professional development at ZOLLER provide solid, practice-oriented technical knowledge. Participants can use this knowledge immediately and directly in their respective manufacturing companies to work efficiently and productively.
